cases.name: 50+ independent observations on the street → STRONG, the street level carries most of the estimate
10–20 observations → observed SUPPORTED stays; the model sits beside it
5–9 observations → observed LIMITED stays LIMITED; the model is not STRONG unless ≥ 2 parcels and recent
1–4 observations → observed INSUFFICIENT (price "—") stays; the model may estimate with parent evidence
zero observations on the street → an estimate only from its blocks / neighbourhood, never STRONG; else MODEL UNAVAILABLE
one project dominates the street → largest parcel stated; never STRONG
one parcel with a few deals → nEff below its deal count; never STRONG
a mostly probable-new street → the estimate is for an EXISTING reference dwelling; "new (probable)" is a stated input
a mostly existing street → the reference dwelling matches its stock; no new-home premium applied
high-volume locality (Tel Aviv-Yafo) → STRONG estimates with the city validated on its own held-out deals
small locality → an estimate only with enough locality depth (n_eff ≥ 8), never STRONG below 300
verified neighbourhood → its level appears with its own weight
no neighbourhood link → the estimate stands on street + blocks + locality, no neighbourhood weight
stale direct evidence (latest street deal > 18 months) → never STRONG; the date is stated
unusual size mix → each comparable is translated to the reference dwelling (dwelling adjustment stated per comparable)
weak-coverage locality → MODEL UNAVAILABLE with its reason, never a locality figure in the street's place
